properties.name: BFL 4
properties.notes: The original application was submitted with an Environmental Statement. The approved scheme is a mixed use regeneration project comprising a new community building, enhancements to a Scheduled Ancient Monument and a mixed use development comprising both new build elements and change of use to include offices, library, residential, retail, café/restaurant, and light industrial uses, with associated public realm works, demolition, landscaping, engineering works and car parking provision.. Mixed use regeneration scheme including 75 residential units
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
